- AXS checkout/hold 刷新后的价格校验链路

- 补入 `skip price validation` 相关提交

为避免 cherry-pick 过程

openPRs.title: feat: pluggable cache framework with Redis backend (demo: GET /user/vanity-url)
openPRs.author: ruicaiext-1m
openPRs.body:
## Summary

Follow-up to the 2026-04-15 production incident (vanityUrl ILIKE full-table scan).
Adds a generic, storage-agnostic caching layer to protect hot endpoints from DB overload.

- **`CacheStore` interface** (`CACHE_STORE` token) — decouples all business code from Redis implementation; swap to Memcached/in-memory with zero callers changed
- **`RedisCacheStore`** — shares the existing ioredis connection via `@InjectRedis()`; all Redis errors are caught and logged, never rethrow to callers
